standard.note: Final step of SB 15 (2021): $10.50 (2022), $11.75 (2023), $13.25 (2024), $15.00 (2025). No further increase for 2026 and no escalator.

tipped.note: Delaware's $2.23 cash wage is one of the lowest in the country in a $15 state -- a $12.77 tip credit, the second largest of any state after Nebraska's.

indexation.note: SB 15 contained no escalator; the rate is flat until the legislature acts.
